sources.title: AI Telco Troubleshooting Challenge — Track 2 Winner
sources.snippet: Team islab_snu from Seoul National University developed a score-based Bayesian hypothesis selection framework built on top of a LoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B model. Their solution achieved first place in Track 2 and showed strong performance on telecom fault diagnosis tasks. The Core Idea: Bayesian Reasoning Over Network Logs

sources.snippet: Today, we are excited to introduce the latest addition to the Qwen family: Qwen2.5. Dense, easy-to-use, decoder-only language models, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants. Pretrained on our latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18T tokens.
